A BlitzLLVM extension: sets the brightest value in nits that [AutoHDR](AutoHDR) mode 2 lifts highlights to. By default (0) it is what the system says the display can show (SDR white times the room above it, see [HWHDRPeakNits](HWHDRPeakNits)), or 1000 if the system does not say. A peak below the brightness of SDR white is raised to it. The system is also told this value as the brightest content (see [AutoHDRMetadata](AutoHDRMetadata)). The environment variable `BLITZLLVM_AUTOHDR_PEAK` sets it at start.
@param nits  The peak in nits, from 1 to 10000, or 0 for the one of the display.
